interfaceInvariant: Theorem planning, materialization, replay, and combined extraction are ordinary public CLI behavior shared by people, scripts, editors, and models; no caller-specific command, default, threshold, or hidden evidence path is permitted.
guaranteeInvariant: V1 capsules are closure-complete, locked/rebuildable module-prefix packages only after exact planning, safe materialization, and successful clean-room Lean replay. Global minimality, declaration-minimality, offline vendoring, system hermeticity, and independent Ladon proof authority are explicit nonclaims.
closureInvariant: Semantic declaration closure and module/build closure are separate typed graphs. Bounded report projections, lexical names, copied bytes, or successful materialization alone cannot establish capsule completeness or verification.

dependencySemantics.enables: Later child changes allowed to start after this child's portable exit class passes.
